dispute_evidence.claim: exports.default.fetch() in @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers follows redirects by default; the followed request to /settings has no Worker handler and lands on app.notFound() (404, no Location). No genuine 3xx redirect implementation can satisfy the assertions as written.
dispute_evidence.proposed_resolution: Amend the assertions to observe the redirect without auto-following (redirect: "manual"). Test-authoring fix routed through the test pair; the Task 9 implementation should not change.

command_independent_verification.reading: the >=300 assertion now PASSES and <400 fails, so the observed status is 404, not the 200 of the old plain-text page; 404 is reachable only via app.notFound(), which requires a request for /settings to have reached the Worker — i.e. the 302 was followed. Location absent on the final response, so new URL('', CALLBACK) resolves to /oauth/callback.
